dataset_family: Wuhan community sample (5 residential communities; derivation 2020-21, external validation 2022; Huazhong University of Science and Technology)
method_family: Phone-video-timed dual-task (serial 7s) gait speed and dual-task cost + years of education; forward-stepwise logistic regression
what_it_shows: A dual-task (serial 7s) gait model, timed from phone video and adjusted for education, discriminated clinically diagnosed MCI in Wuhan community elders: AUC 0.906 (accuracy 83.1%) in derivation and AUC 0.913 on external validation. MoCA alone scored higher (AUC 0.989).
why: The PDF matches the block: Yang et al., Arch Phys Med Rehabil 2024;105:930-8; a Wuhan community gait model with external validation. Read in full; the online-only supplementary tables and figures are not in the PDF. INSTRUMENT. A tester runs one single-task and three dual-task 10 m walks, timed and step-counted from mobile-phone video. The paper says it 'does not require professional equipment, only a 10-meter walkway and a mobile phone'. MCI is diagnosed clinically by specialist physicians (NIA-AA criteria). MODEL. Forward-stepwise logistic regression on gait speed, the dual-task cost of gait speed and years of education. RESULTS. The serial-7s model, in the derivation sample (in-sample, at the optimal cut-off; Table 4): AUC 0.906, accuracy 83.10%, sensitivity 83.87%, specificity 85.48%. On external validation: AUC 0.913, sensitivity 95.45%, specificity 81.40%; external accuracy is not reported. AGAINST TABLE A1. Consumer device: yes (phone). Behavioural: yes. Self-administered: no, a trained tester runs the test. Accuracy: 83.1%, below the ~88-94% band. AUC ~0.91 is high discrimination, but the statement's band is stated as accuracy. The paper also runs a within-study comparison against MoCA. MoCA is a clinician-administered screening instrument, not specialist hardware, and it is part of the diagnostic evidence. MoCA's AUC of 0.989 exceeded the gait model's 0.906, and MoCA + gait also beat gait alone. Two of the statement's conditions fail (self-administered, accuracy band). Verdict: no. AGAINST THE NARROWED WORDING. It fits 'low-cost behavioural data captured without specialist hardware'. It exceeds the wording's description of the evidence, because it has external validation. Its best-case accuracy (83.1%) is below 'about 88-94%'. Its MoCA comparison is a head-to-head of a kind the wording says is absent; whether MoCA counts as a 'specialist instrument' is an operator call. Verdict: partly, on the low-cost behavioural element and the high discrimination only. REPORTING INCONSISTENCIES. The abstract gives the derivation sample as 134 (69 CN/65 MCI), but the methods and Table 1 give 62/62 (124). Table 2 gives the validation sample as 46 CN/19 MCI (29.2% prevalence), yet an external sensitivity of 95.45% cannot be reached with 19 cases. Derived arithmetic: 95.45% = 21/22 and 81.40% = 35/43. The glyph between 0.845 and 0.982 in the CI is an extraction artefact standing for a dash. INDEPENDENCE. Recruited from 5 residential communities in Wuhan: distinct from P-101's Shanghai/Henan communities and from I-CONECT (P-76/P-77). No authors are shared with the supporters or with the other candidates. The registry row's sample (204; 69/65) copies the abstract, not Table 1.
